title: Brogaard & Detzel 2015 MS: EPU innovations and future US500 returns
note: Baker-Bloom-Davis EPU index (free, monthly). An EPU innovation predicts higher US500 returns over the next 2-3 months. EPU-gold was dropped as in-sample only; this is the equity test and must pass OOS after 2015. Fits gap 3. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only.
